whatIsIt.eli5: Keeps only the strongest value in each small square.
whatIsIt.simple: Takes the maximum in each k×k window. With stride 1 and padding k//2 the size stays the same.
whatIsIt.engineer: nn.MaxPool2d(k, s, p); no params, zero MACs.

whyExists.eli5: To notice a pattern anywhere in a small area.
whyExists.simple: Spreads strong responses over a neighbourhood, growing the field of view for free.
